title: STMicroelectronics
subtitle: Application engineering on traction inverters and motor control
pitch: Six months on the Global Key Account Customers team, bridging ST silicon and customer products, including debugging a customer's 3-phase traction inverter on real hardware.
highlights: Debugged a customer's custom traction motor inverter with Lauterbach JTAG and the StellarStudio IDE
Independently diagnosed a DC-bus instability and implemented a parallel-capacitor fix, validated under load
Found firmware bugs in Clarke/Park, space-vector modulation, and PWM code and supplied corrected code
Produced PWM and SVM parameterization guides

blocks.md: As an Application Engineer Intern on the Global Key Account Customers (GKAC) team, I supported customers in microcontroller project development across automotive and industrial applications.

blocks.heading: The work
items: Debugged a customer's custom 3-phase traction motor inverter on real hardware, resolving PWM timing faults, gate-driver issues, and current-sensing calibration errors.

Independently diagnosed a DC-bus instability, then proposed and implemented a parallel-capacitor fix between the inverter and the power supply, validated under load with oscilloscope and logic analyzer.
Identified firmware bugs in the motor-control algorithms (Clarke/Park transforms, space-vector modulation, PWM) and supplied corrected code.
Produced PWM and space-vector-modulation parameterization guides for internal and customer-facing use.
Ran hardware teardowns and reverse-engineering analysis of competitive automotive electronics modules, catalogued the components against ST's portfolio, and presented the analysis to ST marketing.
